# Delib · 審議拼圖

Delib helps non-engineers compose offline and online deliberation workflows,
select open-source tools, and leave an inspectable receipt for the next round.

- Human site: https://delib.mashbean.net/
- Agent skill: https://delib.mashbean.net/.well-known/delib/SKILL.md
- Tool registry: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/tools.json
- Integration audit: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/integrations.json
- Source and hosting audit: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/hosting.json
- Integration API: https://delib.mashbean.net/api/integrations
- Source: https://github.com/mashbean/delib

Recommendations are deterministic and source-linked. AI may explain or format a
selected workflow but must not invent consensus, participant evidence, or
decision authority.

Direct actions currently implemented:

- POST /api/integrations/call-in — create a confirmed seven-day hosted event.
- POST /api/integrations/polis — validate and prepare an embedded Pol.is workspace.
- GET /api/integrations/polis/status — report whether this deployment has a connected Site ID.
- POST /api/integrations/heyform — validate and prepare an existing public HeyForm workspace.
- POST /api/integrations/tttc — prepare the current official Talk to the City create workspace.
- POST /api/integrations/harmonica — create a confirmed Harmonica session with a tab-only API key.

Every preparation or external-write path requires an explicit `confirmed: true`
human gate. HeyForm, TTTC and Harmonica participant data remain upstream;
Harmonica credentials are forwarded once and never stored by Delib.
